info.name: Fordefi Webhooks API
info.description:
These endpoints allow you to manually trigger your pre-configured webhooks.

Use Webhooks describes how to configure webhooks, validate them, and resend them.

Webhooks deliver the full set of details about the transaction as retrieved by a call to the Get Transaction endpoint.
